newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: UTAMA BANKING SHARES DEBUT AT 3.30 RGT.
newsitem.headline: UTAMA BANKING SHARES DEBUT AT 3.30 RGT.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian financial services firm Utama Banking Group Bhd made their stock market debut at 3.30 ringgit against a 3.0 ringgit offer price.
The company offered 41.153 million new shares for its listing on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
At 0140 GMT, the stock was at 3.42 ringgit, after trading between 3.18 and 3.46 ringgit on volume of 6.74 million.
Utama Banking forecast net profit of 99.36 million ringgit and earnings per share (EPS) of 14.5 cents for the year to December 31, 1997.
Last year, its net profit was 54.05 million ringgit and EPS 20.8 cents on turnover of 491.06 million ringgit.
